nodes.label: Expo migration — running the tutor natively so it survives a locked screen
nodes.rationale: SUPERSEDED: this note's hybrid WebView shell proposal and its assumption that the existing signed-URL mint carries over to React Native are both wrong, since the RN ElevenLabs SDK is WebRTC-only and throws on signedUrl. Also its advice to hand-copy the tutor contract into the native app is superseded by the later shareable-core refactor, which extracted a shared package specifically because hand-copied contracts drift silently.
